events.summary: Bigger text, if you want it • Settings has a new Text size choice: Normal, Large or Very large. • It scales the reading text: event narration, event outcomes and the mission report. Normal stays exactly as it was. Your hall, your way • A slim column of switches on the left edge shows or hides the side menu, the guild banner, the next steps and the alerts. • Everything starts in view. events.title: Demo Patch 0.11.1
events.summary: You can see who is on the other side• When a scene declares an enemy, the event header now names them and says how dangerous they are, in words: a noble of notable power, a Mistmaw Stag of moderate danger. Hover the line for what is known about them. • Until now the only place the foe was ever named was the tooltip of the Fight button. The infirmary states the odds and the outlook before you pay• Every care card says how dependable it is (Dependable, Uneven, Chancy, A gamble) and, for daily care

events.title: Demo Patch 0.11.0
events.summary: Our biggest update yet. The demo stops being a corridor with a door at the end: the guided first contract now opens onto the free game, with a living realm, a real economy, and a company that reads like people instead of stat blocks. Your company reads like people now• Thirteen callings in the classic tabletop mold, and each fights its own way: wizards conjure, clerics pray, bards play, rogues strike from cover. Nobody is forced onto brute steel anymore. • Seventy-five origins, ten per calling,
